svg.text: PHANTOM = TRIGGER AT THE SELECTED ROW.
LABEL ORIGIN: B + S1 + S2 = B + S4 = 15.
TRAILING CHECK SLOT EXISTS ON EVERY ROW.
MOUSE / KEYBOARD: SELECTED VALUE STAYS ANCHORED.
CHECK SLOT IS TRAILING; LABELS SHARE ONE ORIGIN.
SEARCH HEADER IS PINNED ABOVE THE LIST.
LIST IS THE SCROLL VIEWPORT, NOT A CHILD OF IT.
TOUCH / EDGE / NO ROOM: DROPDOWN FALLBACK.
PLAIN TRIGGER USES CONTENT-WIDTH BY DEFAULT.
TWO PRODUCTION ROOT USES IN TWO DEMO FILES.
ALL THREE SIZES AND FOUR VARIANTS REVIEWED.
ENVELOPE = MAXIMUM OF BOTH SHADOW LAYERS.
BLUR HAS NO HARD CUTOFF; THIS IS A CONVENTION.
SCROLL AREA ROOT → VIEWPORT RENDERS LIST.
ROOT MAX-HEIGHT: 100%; NO FIXED ROW CAP.
H4 OVERLAYS SHOWN SEPARATELY FOR CLARITY.
SEARCH ADDS H3; ARROWS ARE ABSOLUTE OVERLAYS.
PROPORTIONAL SCHEMATIC · SEPARATION NOT TO SCALE
NO SCRIM. ROW HEIGHT IS THE ACTUAL HIT HEIGHT.
SEARCH RETAINS ACTIVE ROW; ELSE EXIT GOES DORMANT.
SCALE 5:1 · ACTUAL ROW AND CONCENTRIC REFERENCE
DASH-DOT R4 SHARES THE PANEL ARC CENTRE.
CHECK IS RESERVED EVEN WHEN UNSELECTED.
VALUE PREFIX IS OPTIONAL; WIDTH IS HUG.
SCALE 1:1 · HUG TRIGGER, PANEL FLOOR WC
